tiers.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; p=Path("docs/autoresearch-campaign/stuck-recovery.md"); text=p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"); required=("controlled-stuck-recovery","autoresearch.inject.worker_stuck","worker.stuck","task.requeued","worker.stuck.recovered","task.dispatched","stuck_injection_requested_count","worker_stuck_count","worker_stuck_recovered_count","worker_stuck_recovery_failed_count","review.approved","test.passed","judge.passed","discriminator.passed",".zf/events.jsonl"); missing=[item for item in required if item not in text]; assert p.is_file() and text.strip() and not missing, missing'

tiers.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c 'from zf.autoresearch.stuck_incident import audit_stuck_incident,read_worktree_events; from pathlib import Path; events=read_worktree_events(Path.cwd()); audit=audit_stuck_incident(events,required=True); pos={e.id:i for i,e in enumerate(events)}; stuck=next((e for e in events if e.id==audit.stuck_event_id),None); requeue=next((e for e in events if stuck and e.type=="task.requeued" and e.task_id==audit.task_id and e.causation_id==stuck.id and str(e.payload.get("dispatch_id") or "")==audit.dispatch_id),None); recovered=next((e for e in events if e.id==audit.recovery_event_id),None); redispatch=next((e for e in events if recovered and e.type=="task.dispatched" and e.task_id==audit.task_id and pos[e.id]>pos[recovered.id] and str(e.payload.get("dispatch_id") or "") and str(e.payload.get("dispatch_id") or "")!=audit.dispatch_id and str(e.payload.get("assignee") or "")==audit.instance_id),None); correlation_ok=bool(stuck and recovered and redispatch) and (not stuck.correlation_id or (recovered.correlation_id==stuck.correlation_id and redispatch.correlation_id==stuck.correlation_id)); manual=[e.id for e in events if e.type=="task.status_changed" and (e.actor!="zf-cli" or e.origin=="worker")]; invalid=[e.id for e in events if e.type=="task.invalid_transition"]; order_ok=bool(requeue and recovered and redispatch) and pos[requeue.id]<pos[recovered.id]<pos[redispatch.id]; result={"audit":audit.to_dict(),"requeue_event_id":requeue.id if requeue else "","redispatch_event_id":redispatch.id if redispatch else "","order_ok":order_ok,"correlation_ok":correlation_ok,"manual_status_mutation_ids":manual,"invalid_transition_ids":invalid}; print(result); assert audit.ok and order_ok and correlation_ok and not manual and not invalid, result'
tiers.purpose: 证明原 dispatch/injection/stuck、requeue/recovered 与不同的新 dispatch 属于同 task/instance/correlation incident，并扫描 manual mutation
tiers.pass: audit.ok、order_ok、correlation_ok 为 true；manual_status_mutation_ids 与 invalid_transition_ids 为空

tiers.purpose: 从同一 run 的 state_dir/cwd 回查恢复链、artifact refs 与 judge 的前置 gate events
tiers.pass: refs verify exit_code=0；ledger 中存在 review.approved、test.passed；judge 随后独立 emit judge.passed，kernel discriminator 再消费该事件

tiers.purpose: 在 runner 退出后验证同一 real-provider run 的最终 report、summary 和 resolved output paths

cleanup.note: 当前 worktree 含本 run 交付和外层证据，是否移除由 resident owner 决定；内层 worker 不强制删除。

scope_notes: arch 不运行 T-02 至 T-06，也不代替 test/judge 宣布通过。
T-04/T-05 使用当前 run，不带 --confirm、不启动 provider；T-06 是外层已启动 real-provider run 的 post-run 检查。
report.md/events-summary.json 在 inner runner 退出后才生成，因此 T-06 不得作为内层 worker completion 的伪造前置证据。
完整 pytest 不是本设计阶段默认要求；真实 provider/host 结果必须单独标注。
